messages:
Maria G: Quick check on dedicated capacity buildout — can folks drop status on GPU procurement, cluster readiness, capacity reservations, and blockers? Trying to nail timelines for enterprise customer onboarding.

Ajay K: Procurement update — H100 batch shipping delayed ~1 week. New ETA 2026-03-25. We kept 32 spare A100s as fallback. PO# INV-10234 placed with vendor, following up tomorrow. :frowning: 

Lia Chen: Cluster bring-up: base images baked, CUDA/driver validated. KVM nodes provisioning in progress. Waiting on firewall rule from eng-security (ticket SEC-441). Once that lands I can run e2e smoke in ~6 hours.

Tom R: Capacity reservations: reserved 200 GPU slots on dedicated pool (reservation ID rsv-202603). Autoscaling policy draft posted in the reservation ticket. Need expected steady QPS + burst numbers from product to tune -- @Sarah P can you provide?

Sarah P: Test harness: I can start canary evals once model artifact v1.2 and container image tag are available. Also need prompt sets for regression checks. Pinged ML infra to build image.

Ajay K: Also submitted quota bump for project-redwood-dedicated in us-west1 (GCP ticket GCP-789). If quota not approved we'll fallback to hosted instances temporarily. Link: https://console.cloud.google.com/quotas/ (GCP-789)

Lia Chen: Small runtime config note: KV cache persistence is OFF by default. Enabling it requires extra disk (approx +10%). Flag to toggle: runtime.config.cache_persist=true

Tom R: Autoscaling snippet I'm proposing:
```
policy:
  min_replicas: 10
  max_replicas: 250
  target_latency_ms: 120
```
Start canary with 10 GPUs for 48h, monitor latency/cost, then scale to steady.

Maria G: Owners: Ajay -> procurement & quota, Lia -> cluster bring-up & runtime config, Tom -> reservations & autoscale, Sarah -> test harness & artifacts. Please update ticket links in this thread. Target ETA for full capacity: aim EOW (2026-03-27) but contingent on GCP quota and H100 arrival.

ops-bot: Ticket update: SEC-441 assigned to eng-security@redwood, GCP-789 status PENDING.

Ajay K: I'll escalate PO tomorrow AM and update here. @Maria G :thumbsup:

Sarah P: I'll upload test artifacts and post container tag by EOD.

Lia Chen: If quota takes >48h we'll enable A100 fallback pool — requires config flip, I'll open PR now.

Tom R: I'll lock reservation ID in the calendar and add canary job to releases board.

Maria G: Thanks — short updates only in thread. If anything blocks, ping #eng-infra on call.
